_: Edge-case keys written by Claude from the plans' own words (rag.provision text as at 2026-04-07) on lots chosen from cadastre + epi layers + derived.lot_profile - never from side D. Status 'draft' until Manni confirms. 06-questions.ts asks each one 'Under <plan>, ...'. verdict 'maybe' = the answer turns on a fact of the proposal or on the consent authority's judgement, not given with the question.
convention: verdicts follow the pipeline's convention: a condition about the lot (its area, frontage, a map area) that the lot fails is 'no' (unless varied under cl 4.6); a condition about the proposal or the consent authority's judgement leaves the use permissible - 'yes', and D must list the clause as a limit (subject_to); 'maybe' only where the permission itself turns on such a condition (a Schedule 1 item 'permitted ... if')

keys.note: 105 Pacific Hwy is in Area 6 on the APU Map (zone R4, whose table does not list shops - prohibited). Sch 1 item 6(2)(c): shops permitted with consent on Area 6 land.
Sch 1 item 6 permits business premises, restaurants or cafes, shops and take away food and drink premises - not office premises, a different use. R4 does not list office premises: prohibited.
17 Brooklyn Rd is in Area 2 on the APU Map (R2, which does not list home industries). Sch 1 item 2: home industries permitted with consent.

R2's table does not list dual occupancies (item 4: any development not specified in item 2 or 3). Cl 4.1C sets a dual-occupancy lot size in R2 but grants no permission - under the LEP alone, prohibited.
49 Cardinal Av, R2, not in a heritage conservation area: cl 4.1C(3)(b)(ii) - dual occupancies (detached) on a lot of at least 800m2.
Same lot: cl 4.1C(3)(b)(i) - dual occupancies (attached) 700m2. Attached and detached differ.
15 Chapman Av, R2, inside a heritage conservation area (Heritage Map): cl 4.1C(3)(a)(ii) - 900m2, not 800.

927m2 into 2 lots after a lawfully erected dual occupancy (detached): cl 4.1D(3) despite cl 4.1 (Lot Size Map 600m2); not in a heritage conservation area, so (5)(b): each lot at least 400m2 - about 463m2 each.
10 Kristy Pl, 743m2: about 371m2 each, under cl 4.1D(5)(b)'s 400m2 and under the Lot Size Map's 600m2 - no.
15 Chapman Av, 869m2 in a heritage conservation area: cl 4.1D(4)(b) needs 450m2 each - about 434m2 each, no (it would pass the 400m2 outside one).
7 Geelans Rd, RU4, 2,437m2 on a Lot Size Map of 2ha: RU4 lists dual occupancies (attached), but cl 6.9(3) - consent must not be granted on a lot less than the Lot Size Map minimum.

3 Roscommon Rd, RU4, 2.77 ha (over the Lot Size Map's 2 ha, so cl 6.9(3) does not bar it): permitted, subject to cl 6.9(4) - the gross floor area of at least one of the two dwellings must be under 200m2, a fact of the proposal, not of the lot.

12-14 Berowra Waters Rd, E1: shop top housing is permitted in E1, subject to cl 6.10 - consent only if the consent authority is satisfied there is no net loss of non-residential floor area (shop top housing is residential accommodation in the Dictionary).
16 Elva Av (Lot 8, DP 11885), R2 - which lists no dual occupancies. Sch 1 item 1 names this lot: a dual occupancy (detached) permitted with consent.
Same lot: Sch 1 item 1 permits only the detached kind; R2 does not list dual occupancies - attached is prohibited here.
R2: cl 4.1A(3) - dual occupancies on a lot of at least 1,015m2 (this lot is 1,208m2).
164 Mona Vale Rd St Ives is in Area 5 on the APU Map (E1, whose table prohibits residential accommodation, which includes hostels). Sch 1 item 89: hostels permitted with consent.
60 Wallalong Cr, R2, 1,063m2 with a lawfully erected dual occupancy: cl 4.1B(3) despite cl 4.1; (4)(a) each lot at least 507.5m2 - about 531m2 each.
8 Patterson Av, 991m2: about 495m2 each, under cl 4.1B(4)(a)'s 507.5m2 - no.
14 Bruce Av, R4, not in Area 1, 2 or 3 of the Lot Size Map: cl 6.6(2) - at least 1,200m2 (and 24m wide and deep under 1,800m2).
3 Powell St, R4, in Area 3 on the Lot Size Map: cl 6.6(2A) - (2) does not apply; (5)(a) - at least 1,500m2, not 1,200.
2 Anzac Av Cammeray (Lot 2, DP 1080152), zoned SP2 - which does not list registered clubs. Sch 1 item 1 names the lot: a registered club permitted with consent.
Same lot: Sch 1 item 1 permits a registered club and recreation facilities (indoor and outdoor) - not a pub; SP2 does not list pubs.

11 Cowdroy Av, Cammeray (Lot 62 DP 8933), R2: the table prohibits dual occupancies (detached) and cl 6.6(1)(b) requires the dwellings to be attached, but Schedule 1 item 45 permits a dual occupancy (detached) on this lot and cl 2.5(2) gives Schedule 1 effect despite anything to the contrary in the Land Use Table or any other provision of the Plan.

30 Milner Cr, Wollstonecraft, R2, 691m2, named in no Schedule 1 item: the table prohibits dual occupancies (detached), and cl 6.6(1)(b) would bar one anyway (the dwellings must be attached by at least 80% of the common wall, floor or ceiling) - the contrast to N3.

11 Cowdroy Av, 520m2 (over cl 6.6(1)(c)'s 450m2, so the lot passes): permitted, subject to cl 6.6(1)(a)-(b) - the building must appear as a dwelling house and the dwellings must share at least 80% of a common wall, floor or ceiling, facts of the proposal.
4 Grafton St Cremorne, R2, 430m2: cl 6.6(1)(c) - consent must not be granted unless the lot is at least 450m2.
208 Blues Point Rd, E1: office premises are permitted in E1, subject to cl 6.14 - only if the consent authority is satisfied they will be above ground floor or away from the primary street frontage.

Grosvenor Lane, MU1: residential flat buildings are permitted, subject to cl 6.12A - only if the consent authority is satisfied the building is part of a mixed use development with no ground floor street frontage used for residential accommodation.
2 Metcalfe St Cammeray, SP2 land identified as Railway / Classified road on the Land Zoning Map (SP2's table does not list signage). Sch 1 item 43: signage permitted with consent.
11 Norwood Av Beecroft, R2 (which lists dual occupancies), on land identified as D on the Dual Occupancy Prohibition Map: cl 6.11(1) - consent must not be granted to dual occupancies of either kind.
213A Windsor Rd Northmead, R2, one street frontage, not a corner lot, no heritage item, not in the South Parramatta Conservation Area: cl 6.11(2) bars a dual occupancy (detached).

Same lot, 652m2 but a 13.89m frontage: cl 4.1C(2) - a dual occupancy may be carried out only on a lot of at least 600m2 with at least a 15m wide frontage to a public road. The frontage fails, so even attached is not permitted here.

43 Iron St North Parramatta, R2, a corner lot with 2 frontages: cl 6.11(2)(b)-(c) lift the bar; 719m2 with an 18.49m frontage meets cl 4.1C(2). Permitted with consent. (Corner lot within the Codes SEPP meaning - taken from the lot data.)
R2: cl 4.1C(2)(a) - at least 600m2 (and a 15m frontage).

17 Carlton Rd North Rocks, R2, on land identified as S on the Dual Occupancy Prohibition Map: cl 6.19(3) - no subdivision putting each dwelling on its own lot; the only exception is a pre-1996 consent subdivided under a strata plan, not Torrens title.
2A Edward St Northmead, RE1 (which does not list centre-based child care facilities), in Area 5 on the APU Map: Sch 1 item 5 permits them with consent.

Windsor Rd North Rocks, E3 (item 4 lists retail premises), in Area 14 on the APU Map: Sch 1 item 14 permits retail premises only if they mainly sell groceries, foodstuffs and liquor and retail floor area stays at or under 3,800m2 - facts of the proposal.
